article-meta.related-article: This corrects the article "Valemetostat Tosilate: First Approval" on page 1621.

body.p: The article Valemetostat Tosilate: First Approval, written by Susan J. Keam, was originally published electronically in SpringerLink on 15 November without open access. After publication in volume 82, issue 16, pages 1621–1627, Daiichi Sankyo Co. Ltd, requested that the article be Open Choice to make the article an open access publication. Post-publication open access was funded by Daiichi Sankyo Co. Ltd.
